territorial_scope.description: Applies to authorities and actors within Greece implementing the EU AI Regulation domestically.

evidence.quote: η δημιουργία πλαισίου για την εποπτεία των συστημάτων Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Greek Law 5321/2026 sets national measures implementing the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689): designates market surveillance, notifying and single-contact authorities, creates an AI regulatory sandbox, a public-sector AI registry and an AI observatory, sets administrative sanctions, and criminalises removing deepfake labels. Takes effect on publication unless provisions say otherwise.
summary.long: Part A of Law 5321/2026 implements Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 in Greece. The Personal Data Protection Authority is designated market surveillance authority for prohibited practices, high-risk systems listed in Annex III and transparency duties under Article 50, and also acts as single point of contact. The Greek telecommunications regulator (EETT) is the notifying authority and hosts a coordination centre. A single complaints system is established. A regulatory sandbox is set up, and real-world testing of high-risk systems outside sandboxes requires prior written permission from the competent authority. Administrative measures include warnings, orders, reprimands and fines under Article 99 of the AI Regulation; periodic penalties against undertakings are capped at 2% of average daily worldwide turnover, and sanction decisions must be published. Public bodies must file a declaration before operating an AI system in a central register. Article 23 makes removing machine-readable marks on synthetic content, or the related disclosure, punishable by imprisonment and a fine where no heavier provision applies. Part B contains mostly unrelated provisions. Article 58 provides that the law enters into force on publication in the Government Gazette unless otherwise stated.

relations.note: Part A is the national measures implementing the Regulation. Registry ID for the Regulation not verified, so left empty.
